metadata.name: Antarctic 1997/98 EMR Radar Profiles (97)
metadata.description: The CSV contains 97 radar profile records collected during the Antarctic season 1997/98. Each record has a constant season identifier, a unique Profile ID, the instrument used (EMR), a radar product pulse length (either 60 ns or 600 ns), and references to associated files: a netCDF data file, its size, a GIS KML file, and a JPEG image. All fields are fully populated with no missing values.
